### [hyprland-wiki/configuring/core/_index.md] _index
> [!WARNING]
> The default config is not complete and does not include every Hyprland option or feature.
> For every configuration option, see the pages linked from this wiki section.

The config is located in `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hypr/hyprland.lua`.
In most cases, that maps to `~/.config/hypr/hyprland.lua`.

You can pass arguments while starting Hyprland (`start-hyprland`), but you must pass your arguments after `--`.
For instance, to use `--config` (or `-c`) to make Hyprland load a non-default config, you might use `start-hyprland -- --config ~/myRices/medium_rare/hyprland.lua`.

If no configuration exists, Hyprland will create an [example config](https://github.com/hyprwm/Hyprland/blob/main/example/hyprland.lua).
Remove `hl.config({ autogenerated = true })` to remove the autogenerated warning banner.

Configuration is reloaded when changes to files are detected.
To reload manually, use `hyprctl reload`.

To get information (class, size, tags, etc.), use:
- `hyprctl clients` to show all windows
- `hyprctl activewindow` to show only the active window

### [hyprland-wiki/hypr-ecosystem/user/xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland.md] xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland › Configuration

-- This is an example Hyprland Lua config file.
-- Refer to the wiki for more information.
-- https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Start/

-- Please note not all available settings / options are set here.
-- For a full list, see the wiki

-- You can (and should!!) split this configuration into multiple files
-- Create your files separately and then require them like this:
-- require("myColors")

------------------
---- MONITORS ----
------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Monitors/
hl.monitor({
    output   = "",
    mode     = "preferred",
    position = "auto",
    scale    = "1.5",
    bitdepth = 10,
    cm       = "hdr"
})

---------------------
---- MY PROGRAMS ----
---------------------

-- Set programs that you use
local terminal    = "kitty"
local fileManager = "pcmanfm"
local menu        = "rofit -show drun"

-------------------
---- AUTOSTART ----
-------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Basics/Autostart/

-- Autostart necessary processes (like notifications daemons, status bars, etc.)
-- Or execute your favorite apps at launch like this:
--
hl.on("hyprland.start", function () 
  hl.exec_cmd("openrgb -p None.orp")
end)

-------------------------------
---- ENVIRONMENT VARIABLES ----
-------------------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Advanced-and-Cool/Environment-variables/

hl.env("XCURSOR_SIZE", "24")
hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_SIZE", "24")

-----------------------
----- PERMISSIONS -----
-----------------------

-- See https://wiki.hypr.land/Configuring/Advanced-and-Cool/Permissions/
-- Please note permission changes here require a Hyprland restart and are not applied on-the-fly
-- for security reasons

-- hl.config({
--   ecosystem = {
--     enforce_permissions = true,
--   },
-- })

### [examples/github/parzij__ArchLinux-setup/hypr/hyprland.lua] parzij__ArchLinux-setup/hypr/hyprland.lua
-- Hyprland Lua configuration
-- Аккуратная миграция из актуального рабочего hyprland.conf (audit 2026-07-28).
-- Рабочий hyprland.conf не удалять: этот файл сначала запускается отдельной SDDM-сессией.
-- Все исходные комментарии сохранены; порядок разделов максимально близок к оригиналу.

-- Setup monitors
hl.monitor({
    output = "eDP-1",
    mode = "2560x1600@240",
    position = "0x0",
    scale = 1.25,
})

hl.monitor({
    output = "eDP-2",
    mode = "2560x1600@240",
    position = "0x0",
    scale = 1.25,
})

-- Первая карта - встроенная (для отрисовки интерфейса), вторая - NVIDIA (на подхвате для тяжелых задач)

hl.env("GTK_THEME", "Everforest-B-MB-Dark")
hl.env("GTK_THEME", "Adwaita-dark")
hl.env("QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME", "qt6ct")
hl.env("QT_STYLE_OVERRIDE", "kvantum")

hl.config({
    xwayland = {
        force_zero_scaling = true,
    },
})

hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    hl.exec_cmd("systemctl --user import-environment WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE")
    hl.exec_cmd("systemctl --user start vicinae.service")

    -- Execute your favorite apps at launch
    hl.exec_cmd("dbus-update-activation-environment --systemd WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP")
    hl.exec_cmd("systemctl --user import-environment WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP")
    hl.exec_cmd("/usr/lib/polkit-gnome/polkit-gnome-authentication-agent-1")

    -- exec-once = waybar
    -- Lua equivalent if you enable it later:
    -- hl.exec_cmd("waybar")

    hl.exec_cmd("/usr/bin/quickshell -c parzij-shell")

    --exec-once = swaync
    -- Lua equivalent if you enable it later:
    -- hl.exec_cmd("swaync")

-- =============================================================================
--  hyprland.lua — entry point. ONLY require() lines live here.
--  Comment a line to disable a module. Values live in settings.conf.
-- =============================================================================

-- Core -----------------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.env")             -- environment variables
require("conf.monitors")        -- monitor profile (monitors/*.lua)
require("conf.input")           -- keyboard, mouse, touchpad
require("conf.gestures")        -- touchpad gestures

-- Appearance -----------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.look-and-feel")   -- gaps, borders, rounding, blur, shadows
require("conf.animations")      -- animation preset (conf/animations/*.lua)
require("conf.layouts")         -- dwindle / master options
require("conf.misc")            -- misc behaviour

-- Rules ----------------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.windowrules")     -- floating apps, PiP, dialogs
require("conf.layerrules")      -- blur behind bar / launcher / panels
require("conf.workspaces")      -- workspace rules & scratchpad

-- Keybindings ----------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.keybinds.apps")        -- launch applications
require("conf.keybinds.windows")     -- focus, move, resize, float, group
require("conf.keybinds.workspaces")  -- switch / move to workspaces, scratchpad
require("conf.keybinds.system")      -- launcher, menus, theme, bar, lock, reload
require("conf.keybinds.screenshots") -- capture, annotate, OCR
require("conf.keybinds.media")       -- volume, brightness, players (with OSD)
require("conf.keybinds.switches")    -- laptop lid

-- Session --------------------------------------------------------------------
require("conf.autostart")       -- daemons started once at login

-- Personal overrides (optional, loaded last, not tracked) ---------------------
require("conf.custom")

# =============================================================================
#  settings.conf — THE single place for every user-tweakable value
# =============================================================================
#  Read by:
#    * Hyprland (hypr/lib/settings.lua parses this file)
#    * every shell script (they `source` it through hypr/scripts/lib.sh)
#    * the theming engine (fonts / radius are injected into every template)
#
#  Syntax: shell-compatible  KEY="value"  lines. Comments start with '#'.
#  Only $HOME and ${HOME} are expanded on the Lua side, so keep values simple.
#
#  Runtime toggles (animations, blur, gaps, gamemode, monitor profile) are
#  saved in ~/.local/state/inkpaw/toggles.conf and OVERRIDE these values.
# =============================================================================

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Applications
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
TERMINAL="kitty"
# Command prefix that runs a TUI in a floating terminal (class matched by a window rule)
TERMINAL_FLOAT="kitty --class floating-tui -e"
BROWSER="firefox"
FILEMANAGER="nautilus --new-window"
EDITOR_GUI="gnome-text-editor"
CALCULATOR="gnome-calculator"
# spotlight = sectioned list (spotlight/), walker = Walker
LAUNCHER="spotlight"
# Settings: app = settings window (libadwaita), rofi = rofi menu
SETTINGS_UI="app"
AUDIO_MIXER="pavucontrol"
BLUETOOTH_MANAGER="blueman-manager"

# Personal apps (bound in hypr/conf/keybinds/apps.lua)
APP_CHAT="discord"
APP_MUSIC="spotify-launcher"
APP_TEAMS="teams-for-linux"

# Terminal (kitty) — empty = keep the value of your own kitty.conf
KITTY_FONT=""
KITTY_FONT_SIZE=""
# 0.0 – 1.0 (1 = opaque)
KITTY_OPACITY=""
KITTY_PADDING=""
# block | beam | underline
KITTY_CURSOR=""

# File manager preferences — empty = leave as is
# true | false
FILES_SHOW_HIDDEN=""
# list | grid
FILES_VIEW=""

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Keyboard / input
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MOD="SUPER"
KB_LAYOUT="fr"
KB_VARIANT=""
KB_OPTIONS="grp:alt_shift_toggle"
MOUSE_SENSITIVITY="0"
NATURAL_SCROLL="true"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Monitors (see hypr/monitors/*.lua for the profiles)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
MONITOR_LAPTOP="eDP-2"
MONITOR_EXTERNAL="HDMI-A-1"
# Where the external screen sits relative to the laptop: left | right | above | below
MONITOR_EXTERNAL_SIDE="right"
# Profile used until you pick one with the monitor menu: auto | extended | laptop-only | external-only | mirror
MONITOR_PROFILE="auto"
# Disable the laptop panel when the lid closes and an external screen is connected
LID_SWITCH_HANDLING="true"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Look & feel (Hyprland)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
GAPS_IN="6"
GAPS_OUT="12"
BORDER_SIZE="2"
BORDER_ANGLE="45"
# Slowly rotating gradient border (HyDE-style); small GPU cost
BORDER_ANIMATE="false"
ROUNDING="10"
ACTIVE_OPACITY="0.92"
INACTIVE_OPACITY="0.84"
BLUR="true"
BLUR_SIZE="7"
BLUR_PASSES="3"
SHADOW="true"
# soft = blurred drop shadow | hard = solid offset ink shadow (hand-drawn look)
SHADOW_STYLE="soft"
# Focused window border: gradient (3 accents) | ink (solid text color)
BORDER_STYLE="gradient"
ANIMATIONS="true"
# Animation preset file in hypr/conf/animations/ (without .lua): smooth | md3 | fast | none
ANIMATION_PRESET="smooth"
LAYOUT="dwindle"

CURSOR_THEME="Bibata-Modern-Ice"
CURSOR_SIZE="24"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# UI tokens (injected into Waybar / swaync / walker / rofi / wlogout templates)
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Text font (bar, menus, notifications, launcher, lock screen)
FONT_FAMILY="Google Sans Flex"
# Monospace font (Spotlight list, code)
MONO_FONT="JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"
# Icon font (Nerd Font glyphs used as fallback for icons)
ICON_FONT="CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font"
FONT_SIZE="12"
UI_RADIUS="12"
UI_BORDER="1"
# Background opacity of bars / panels (0.0 – 1.0)
UI_OPACITY="0.72"
# Title font (big headings, workspace numbers in skinned looks); empty = FONT_FAMILY
DISPLAY_FONT=""

# Interface style ("skin"): default | encre (ink & parchment, hand-drawn, cats).
# It only changes the fonts, the look of the apps / menus and the top bar:
# colors, wallpaper, window borders / shadows / gaps and the desktop cat stay yours.
# Change it with  hyprtheme/skin.sh apply <name>  (or Settings → Appearance):
# the skin writes its own fonts / bar / borders (hyprtheme/skins/<name>/skin.conf)
# and the previous values come back with  skin.sh apply default.
UI_SKIN="default"
# Cat peeking from the bottom of the screen (deskpet/), click it to hear it
DESKTOP_PET="false"
# moumoute | gribouille | biscotte | pate | clafoutis | croquette
DESKTOP_PET_CAT="gribouille"

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Bar (Waybar) — everything here can also be changed from the settings menu
# (SUPER+CTRL+S → Bar). The config is generated by waybar/build.py.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# top | bottom
BAR_POSITION="top"
# Monitors showing the bar: "*" = all, or names separated by spaces ("eDP-2 HDMI-A-1")
BAR_OUTPUTS="*"
# Where the capsules go: center (all in the middle) | split (session left,
# clock center, status+system right) | left | right | custom (BAR_LEFT/CENTER/RIGHT)
BAR_LAYOUT="center"
BAR_LEFT="session"
BAR_CENTER="time"
BAR_RIGHT="status system"
# true = put every capsule inside ONE single pill (thin separators between groups)
BAR_SINGLE_CAPSULE="false"
# Look: capsules (floating pills) | floating (one rounded bar) | solid (edge to edge) |

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/env.lua — environment variables
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")
local HOME = S.paths.home

-- PATH: user binaries ---------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("PATH", HOME .. "/.local/bin:" .. HOME .. "/.cargo/bin:" .. (os.getenv("PATH") or ""))

-- Wayland session -------------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP", "Hyprland")
hl.env("XDG_SESSION_TYPE", "wayland")
hl.env("XDG_SESSION_DESKTOP", "Hyprland")
hl.env("DESKTOP_SESSION", "Hyprland")

-- Toolkits --------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("GDK_BACKEND", "wayland,x11,*")
hl.env("GDK_SCALE", "1")
hl.env("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "wayland;xcb")
hl.env("QT_QPA_PLATFORMTHEME", "qt6ct")
hl.env("QT_WAYLAND_DISABLE_WINDOWDECORATION", "1")
hl.env("CLUTTER_BACKEND", "wayland")
hl.env("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "wayland")

-- Electron / browsers -----------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("OZONE_PLATFORM", "wayland")
hl.env("ELECTRON_OZONE_PLATFORM_HINT", "wayland")
hl.env("MOZ_ENABLE_WAYLAND", "1")

-- Fonts: the system config + hyprtheme/fonts (bundled OFL fonts of the skins)
hl.env("FONTCONFIG_FILE", S.paths.theme .. "/fonts/fonts.conf")

-- Cursor ----------------------------------------------------------------------
hl.env("XCURSOR_THEME", S.str("CURSOR_THEME", "Adwaita"))
hl.env("XCURSOR_SIZE", S.str("CURSOR_SIZE", "24"))
hl.env("HYPRCURSOR_SIZE", S.str("CURSOR_SIZE", "24"))

-- XWayland: no blurry scaling
hl.config({ xwayland = { force_zero_scaling = true } })

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/monitors.lua — loads the active monitor profile
-- =============================================================================
--  The profile name comes from MONITOR_PROFILE (settings.conf), overridden by
--  the monitor menu (SUPER+SHIFT+M), which saves it in the state toggles file.
--  Profiles live in hypr/monitors/<name>.lua.
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")

local profile = S.str("MONITOR_PROFILE", "auto")

-- In the nested test session the real outputs don't exist: always use "auto".
if S.test_mode then profile = "auto" end

local ok, err = pcall(require, "monitors." .. profile)
if not ok then
    print("[monitors] profile '" .. profile .. "' failed (" .. tostring(err) .. "), using auto")
    require("monitors.auto")
end

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/gestures.lua — touchpad gestures (kept from your ML4W setup)
-- =============================================================================

-- 3 fingers vertical: switch workspace
hl.gesture({ fingers = 3, direction = "vertical", action = "workspace" })

-- 3 fingers horizontal: scroll-move (scrolling layout)
hl.gesture({ fingers = 3, direction = "horizontal", action = "scroll_move", scale = 0.9 })

-- 4 fingers pinch out / in: fullscreen on / off
hl.gesture({ fingers = 4, direction = "pinchout", action = function()
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ action = "set" }))
end })
hl.gesture({ fingers = 4, direction = "pinchin", action = function()
    hl.dispatch(hl.dsp.window.fullscreen({ action = "unset" }))
end })

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/look-and-feel.lua — gaps, borders, rounding, opacity, blur, shadows
-- =============================================================================
--  Numbers come from settings.conf; colors from the generated theme.
--  GAMEMODE (toggled with SUPER+ALT+G) strips every effect for performance.
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")
local C = require("lib.colors")

local game = S.bool("GAMEMODE", false)
-- "ink" border / "hard" shadow: the hand-drawn look of the encre skin
local ink  = S.str("BORDER_STYLE", "gradient") == "ink"
local hard = S.str("SHADOW_STYLE", "soft") == "hard"

local active_border = ink and C.rgba("on_surface", "ff") or
    -- 3-accent gradient on the focused window (rotates if BORDER_ANIMATE)
    { colors = { C.rgba("a1", "ff"), C.rgba("a3", "ff"), C.rgba("a5", "ff") },
      angle = S.num("BORDER_ANGLE", 45) }

hl.config({
    general = {
        gaps_in     = game and 0 or S.num("GAPS_IN", 10),
        gaps_out    = game and 0 or S.num("GAPS_OUT", 20),
        border_size = game and 1 or S.num("BORDER_SIZE", 2),
        col = {
            active_border   = active_border,
            inactive_border = ink and C.rgba("on_surface", "99") or C.rgba("outline_variant", "40"),
        },
        resize_on_border = true,
        allow_tearing    = false,
        layout           = S.str("LAYOUT", "dwindle"),
    },

    decoration = {
        rounding           = game and 0 or S.num("ROUNDING", 10),
        rounding_power     = 2,
        active_opacity     = game and 1.0 or S.num("ACTIVE_OPACITY", 1.0),
        inactive_opacity   = game and 1.0 or S.num("INACTIVE_OPACITY", 0.9),
        fullscreen_opacity = 1.0,

        -- soft = blurred drop shadow; hard = solid ink block offset down-right
        shadow = {
            enabled        = (not game) and S.bool("SHADOW", true),
            sharp          = hard,
            range          = hard and 1 or 28,
            render_power   = hard and 1 or 3,
            offset         = hard and "5 5" or "0 6",
            color          = hard and C.rgba("shadow", "ff") or C.rgba("shadow", "45"),
            color_inactive = hard and C.rgba("shadow", "99") or C.rgba("shadow", "20"),
        },

        blur = {
            enabled           = (not game) and S.bool("BLUR", true),
            size              = S.num("BLUR_SIZE", 4),
            passes            = S.num("BLUR_PASSES", 4),
            new_optimizations = true,
            ignore_opacity    = true,
            xray              = false,
            noise             = 0.012,
            contrast          = 0.9,
            brightness        = 0.85,
            vibrancy          = 0.18,
        },
    },

    misc = {
        background_color = C.rgba("surface", "ff"),
    },
})

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/animations.lua — loads an animation preset from conf/animations/
-- =============================================================================
--  ANIMATION_PRESET (settings.conf) picks the file. ANIMATIONS=false or
--  GAMEMODE=true disable animations entirely (toggle: SUPER+SHIFT+A).
-- =============================================================================
local S = require("lib.settings")

local enabled = S.bool("ANIMATIONS", true) and not S.bool("GAMEMODE", false)
hl.config({ animations = { enabled = enabled } })

if enabled then
    local preset = S.str("ANIMATION_PRESET", "md3")
    local ok, err = pcall(require, "conf.animations." .. preset)
    if not ok then
        print("[animations] preset '" .. preset .. "' failed: " .. tostring(err))
        require("conf.animations.md3")
    end
end

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/misc.lua — miscellaneous behaviour
-- =============================================================================
hl.config({
    misc = {
        disable_hyprland_logo      = true,
        disable_splash_rendering   = true,
        force_default_wallpaper    = 0,
        initial_workspace_tracking = 1,
        -- 2 = a window opened over a fullscreen one un-fullscreens it and tiles
        -- next to it (from your custom.lua)
        on_focus_under_fullscreen  = 2,
        allow_session_lock_restore = true,
    },
})

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/windowrules.lua — per-application window behaviour
-- =============================================================================
--  Helper: float + center + size for a class regex. Add a line per app.
-- =============================================================================

local function floating(name, class, size)
    hl.window_rule({ name = name, match = { class = class }, float = true, center = true, size = size })
end

-- Floating utilities ------------------------------------------------------------
floating("floating-tui",     "^(floating-tui)$",                  "900 620")  -- nmtui, bluetui… (TERMINAL_FLOAT)

-- AI assistant: a tall window docked on one side (AI_SIDE, AI_WIDTH). aichat.py
-- re-sends this rule at each opening with the exact geometry of the tiled
-- area (hyprctl eval) and widens the outer gap of the workspace, so tiled
-- windows move aside; the values below are only the first-guess fallback. ----
do
    local S   = require("lib.settings")
    local gap = S.num("GAPS_OUT", 12)
    local bar = S.num("BAR_MARGIN", 6) + 41 + gap          -- the bar + its margin + a gap
    local top, bottom = bar, gap
    if S.str("BAR_POSITION", "top") == "bottom" then top, bottom = gap, bar end
    local x = S.str("AI_SIDE", "right") == "left" and tostring(gap)
              or string.format("(monitor_w-window_w-%d)", gap)
    hl.window_rule({
        name  = "aichat",
        match = { class = "^(dev.inkpaw.AIChat)$" },
        float = true,
        size  = string.format("%d (monitor_h-%d)", S.num("AI_WIDTH", 420), top + bottom),
        move  = string.format("%s %d", x, top),
        opacity = "1.0 override 1.0 override",
    })
end

-- Settings window: always fully opaque (readability over the blur) -------------------
hl.window_rule({
    name  = "hypr-settings-opaque",
    match = { class = "^(dev.inkpaw.(Settings|Welcome))$" },
    opacity = "1.0 override 1.0 override",
})

-- =============================================================================
--  conf/autostart.lua — services started once when Hyprland starts
-- =============================================================================
--  One entry per service. Set `enabled = false` (or delete the line) to skip
--  one. `host = true` marks services that touch the host session (systemd env,
--  portals, polkit, idle/suspend): they are skipped in the ./test.sh nested
--  session so the test never interferes with your real desktop.
-- =============================================================================
local S  = require("lib.settings")
local sc = S.script

local services = {
    -- Session plumbing ----------------------------------------------------------
    -- XDG_CONFIG_HOME is exported too when set (SDDM "inkpaw" session), so
    -- D-Bus-activated apps (swaync, portals…) read the same config as the session.
    { name = "systemd-env", host = true,
      cmd = "dbus-update-activation-environment --systemd WAYLAND_DISPLAY XDG_CURRENT_DESKTOP HYPRLAND_INSTANCE_SIGNATURE"
            .. (os.getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") and " XDG_CONFIG_HOME" or "") },
    { name = "portals",     host = true,
      cmd = "systemctl --user restart xdg-desktop-portal-hyprland xdg-desktop-portal" },
    { name = "polkit",      host = true, cmd = "/usr/lib/polkit-gnome/polkit-gnome-authentication-agent-1" },
    { name = "cursor",      cmd = "hyprctl setcursor " .. S.str("CURSOR_THEME", "Adwaita") .. " " .. S.str("CURSOR_SIZE", "24") },

    -- Desktop ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    { name = "wallpaper-daemon", cmd = sc("wallpaper-daemon.sh") },
    { name = "theme-restore",    cmd = S.paths.theme .. "/theme.sh restore" },   -- wallpaper + palette
    { name = "apps-config",      cmd = sc("apps-config.sh") },                    -- kitty settings file
    { name = "waybar",           cmd = sc("waybar.sh") .. " start" },
    -- explicit paths: if swaync were D-Bus-activated it would read ~/.config instead
    { name = "notifications",    cmd = sc("notifications.sh") .. " start" },
    { name = "osd",              cmd = sc("osd.sh") .. " server" },               -- picks the skin style
    -- the cat peeking from the bottom of the screen (only when DESKTOP_PET=true)
    { name = "deskpet",          cmd = sc("deskpet.sh") .. " start" },
    -- quick panel kept in memory (hidden) so the bar buttons open it instantly
    { name = "quickpanel",       cmd = sc("quickpanel.sh") .. " --daemon" },
    -- encre menus kept in memory too (power, cheat sheet, themes, wallpapers)
    { name = "resident-menus",   cmd = sc("resident.sh") .. " all --daemon" },
    -- 4-step welcome window, shown once (until "Ne plus afficher" is ticked)
    { name = "welcome",          cmd = sc("welcome.sh") .. " --first" },

    -- Launcher backend (Elephant) + Walker service for instant opening -------------
    { name = "elephant",         cmd = "elephant" },
    { name = "walker-service",   cmd = "walker --gapplication-service" },

    -- Idle management (switches AC / battery timeouts automatically) ----------------
    { name = "idle",             host = true, cmd = sc("idle.sh") .. " watch" },

    -- Low-battery notifications (laptop + mouse / headset…)
    { name = "battery-alert",    cmd = sc("battery-alert.sh") .. " watch" },
}

-- On exit, drop XDG_CONFIG_HOME from the systemd/D-Bus activation env so a
-- following ML4W session never inherits it.
hl.on("hyprland.shutdown", function()
    if os.getenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME") and not S.test_mode then
        os.execute("systemctl --user unset-environment XDG_CONFIG_HOME")
    end
end)

hl.on("hyprland.start", function()
    for _, s in ipairs(services) do
        if s.enabled ~= false and not (S.test_mode and s.host) then
            hl.exec_cmd(s.cmd)
        end
    end
end)

# Description de ta configuration Hyprland

Ta config est une installation **Hyprland 0.56+** complète et modulaire, organisée autour d'un système de modules Lua (`hypr/conf/*.lua`) chargés depuis un point d'entrée unique (`hypr/hyprland.lua`). Elle combine des fonctionnalités avancées avec une interface personnalisable.

---

## 🎯 Architecture principale

### Point d'entrée : `hypr/hyprland.lua`
Chaque module est chargé via `require()` et peut être commenté pour le désactiver. L'ordre de chargement suit une logique claire :
1. **Core** → env, monitors, input, gestures
2. **Appearance** → look-and-feel, animations, layouts, misc
3. **Rules** → windowrules, layerrules, workspaces
4. **Keybindings** → apps, windows, workspaces, system, media, screenshots, switches
5. **Session** → autostart

### Configuration centralisée : `hypr/settings.conf`
C'est le **seul fichier** où tu modifies les valeurs utilisateur. Il est lu par :
- Hyprland (via `lib/settings.lua`)
- Tous les scripts shell (`source` via `hypr/scripts/lib.sh`)
- Le moteur de theming (fonts, radius injectés dans les templates)

---

## 🖥️ Moniteurs & Hardware

### Configuration des écrans
- **Laptop** : `eDP-2` (intégré)
- **Extérieur** : `HDMI-A-1` (profil `auto`, `extended`, `mirror`, etc.)
- **Gestion du capot** : `LID_SWITCH_HANDLING=true` → désactive le panneau laptop quand un écran externe est connecté

### Input & Gestures
- **Clavier** : AZERTY (`fr`) avec options `grp:alt_shift_toggle`
- **Souris** : sensibilité ajustable, défilement naturel activé
- **Gestes touchpad** :
  - 3 doigts verticaux → changement d'espace
  - 3 doigts horizontaux → scroll-move (déplacement de fenêtre)
  - 4 doigts pincher → plein écran / sortie

---

## 🎨 Apparence & Performance

### Bordures & Gaps
- **Gaps** : internes `6px`, externes `12px`
- **Bordure** : taille `2px`, angle `45°`, style `gradient` (3 accents) ou `ink` (solide)
- **Arrondi** : `10px`
- **Opacité** : active `0.92`, inactive `0.84`

### Effets visuels
- **Blur** : activé, taille `7px`, passes `3`
- **Ombres** : style `soft` (flou) ou `hard` (solide "dessin main")
- **Animations** : présélection `smooth` (md3, fast, none disponibles)

### Curseur
- Thème : `Bibata-Modern-Ice`, taille `24px`

---

## 🖱️ Fenêtres & Layouts

### Tiling
- **Layout** : `dwindle` avec `preserve_split=true`
- **Comportement** : `workspace_back_and_forth=false`, cycles autorisés, passage souris désactivé après bind

### Règles de fenêtres (`conf/windowrules.lua`)
Fenêtres flottantes par défaut :
- TUIs (`floating-tui`, `nmtui`, `bluetui`...)
- Outils système (`pavucontrol`, `blueman`, `nm-editor`, `hypr-settings`, `hypr-welcome`)
- Pickers de fichiers/dossiers (`xdg-desktop-portal-gtk`)

**Picture-in-Picture** : flottante, épinglée, ne vole pas le focus.

**Suppression des demandes maximize** pour éviter les bugs (ex: kitty se rouvrant maximisé).

### Règles de couches (`conf/layerrules.lua`)
Blur derrière :
- Barre (`waybar`), launcher (`walker`, `spotlight`), panneaux (`quickpanel`, `rofi`)
- Dialogues notifications (`swaync-center`, `swayosd`)
- Menu logout (`wlogout`)

---

## ⌨️ Bindings & Shortcuts

### Applications (via Spotlight)
| Bind | Action |
|------|--------|
| `SUPER + RETURN` | Terminal (`kitty`) |
| `SUPER + B` | Navigateur (`firefox`) |
| `SUPER + E` | Gestionnaire fichiers (`nautilus`) |
| `SUPER + C` | Calculatrice (`gnome-calculator`) |
| `SUPER + D` | Discord |
| `SUPER + P` | Spotify |
| `SUPER + O` | Microsoft Teams |

### Fenêtres
- `SUPER + Q` → fermer
- `SUPER + SHIFT + Q` → tuer le processus
- `SUPER + F` → plein écran
- `SUPER + M` → maximiser
- `SUPER + T` → flotter

## 🚀 Services au démarrage (`conf/autostart.lua`)

Services lancés une fois à l'entrée :
1. **Plumbing session** : systemd-env, portals, polkit, curseur
2. **Desktop** : wallpaper-daemon, theme-restore, apps-config (kitty), waybar, notifications, OSD, deskpet (chat), quickpanel (hidden), resident-menus (menus en mémoire), welcome (4-step)
3. **Launcher** : elephant + walker-service
4. **Idle/batterie** : idle.sh (watch), battery-alert.sh (watch)

## 📂 Organisation des fichiers

### Modules Hyprland (`hypr/conf/`)
- `env.lua` → variables d'environnement
- `monitors.lua` → charge le profil actif (`auto`, `extended`, etc.)
- `input.lua` → clavier, souris, touchpad
- `gestures.lua` → gestes touchpad
- `look-and-feel.lua` → gaps, borders, rounding, blur, shadows
- `animations.lua` → charge le preset d'animation
- `layouts.lua` → dwindle options
- `misc.lua` → comportement misc (logo tapé, wallpaper par défaut, etc.)
- `windowrules.lua` → règles de fenêtres
- `layerrules.lua` → blur des couches
- `workspaces.lua` → règles d'espaces (scratchpad)

### Bindings (`hypr/conf/keybinds/`)
- `apps.lua` → lancements d'applications
- `windows.lua` → focus, move, resize, float, group
- `workspaces.lua` → workspaces & scratchpad
- `system.lua` → launcher, menus, theming, bar, session
- `media.lua` → volume, brightness, players
- `screenshots.lua` → captures d'écran
- `switches.lua` → hardware switches (laptop lid)

### Scripts (`hypr/scripts/`)
Scripts shell réutilisables via `source hypr/scripts/lib.sh` :
- `launcher.sh`, `waybar.sh`, `wallpaper-daemon.sh`, `notifications.sh`, `osd.sh`, `quickpanel.sh`, `resident.sh`, `welcome.sh`, `idle.sh`, `battery-alert.sh`, `lock.sh`, `nightlight.sh`, `screenshot.sh`, `toggle-allfloat.sh`, `deskpet.sh`, `apps-config.sh`, `wallpaper-picker.sh`, `theme.sh`, `static-picker.sh`, `aichat.sh`, `menus/*`

### Themes (`hypr/themes/`)
- `current.lua` → thème actif
- `default.lua` → thème par défaut
- `skin-bin/slurp` → scripts de skin (encre, etc.)

### Moniteurs (`hypr/monitors/`)
Profil pour chaque configuration :
- `auto.lua`, `extended.lua`, `laptop-only.lua`, `external-only.lua`, `mirror.lua`

## 🎨 Personnalisation & Skins

### UI Tokens (`settings.conf`)
Fonts, radius, opacity, style injectés dans les templates (bar, menus, notifications, launcher, lock screen) :
- `FONT_FAMILY="Google Sans Flex"`
- `MONO_FONT="JetBrainsMono Nerd Font"`
- `ICON_FONT="CaskaydiaCove Nerd Font"`
- `UI_RADIUS="12"`, `UI_BORDER="1"`
- `UI_OPACITY="0.72"`

### Skins (`hypr/skins/`)
Changer le style global (fonts, bar, borders, wallpaper, desktop cat) :
- `default` → look standard
- `encre` → "ink & parchment", hand-drawn, cats

Commande : `hyprtheme/skin.sh apply <name>` (ou via Settings → Appearance).

### Desktop Pet (`deskpet/`)
Chat qui apparaît en bas de l'écran (cliquer pour entendre) :
- `DESKTOP_PET="false"` par défaut
- Options : `moumoute`, `gribouille`, `biscotte`, `pate`, `clafoutis`, `croquette`

## 📊 Waybar & Quickshell (widgets Wayland)

### Waybar (`waybar/`)
Config JSONC + CSS, modules personnalisés dans `modules/<nom>.jsonc`.
Style : `style/base.css`, `style/colors.css`, `style/presets/<theme>.css`.

Modules disponibles : ai, backlight, battery, bluetooth, clock, cpu, idle_inhibitor, keyboard, launcher, media, memory, network, notifications, power, pulseaudio, separator, settings, taskbar, tray, updates, wallpaper, window, workspaces.

### Quickshell (`quickshell/`)
Widgets QML (version 0.2.1) : `shell.qml` + composants `<Nom>.qml`.
Services : `Quickshell.Services.Pipewire`, `UPower`, `Mpris`, `SystemTray`, `Notifications`.

## 🔧 Gestion des profils & Toggles

### Profils moniteurs
Changés via le menu (`SUPER+SHIFT+M`) ou `settings.conf` :
- `auto` → profil par défaut
- `extended` → tous les écrans
- `laptop-only` / `external-only` → écran unique
- `mirror` → miroir

### Toggles (sauvegardés dans `~/.local/state/inkpaw/toggles.conf`)
- Animations (`ANIMATIONS=true/false`)
- Blur, gaps, gamemode
- Profil moniteur actif

## 📝 Notes importantes

1. **Reload config** : `hyprctl reload` ou `SUPER+SHIFT+R`
2. **Test mode** : la config détecte un environnement de test et utilise des valeurs par défaut (`S.test_mode`)
3. **Permissions** : section commentée dans l'exemple, à activer si besoin
4. **XWayland** : `force_zero_scaling=true` pour éviter les flous
